name: First-time buyers
definition: Exactly 1 paid / not cancelled / not refunded order (includes 1 Temu marketplace buyer C003)
eligible_actions: Service: order + delivery updates; aftercare page; review request after delivery is confirmed (no incentive). Marketing: only the 19 subscribed – compatible add-on (mattress / headboard) after delivery + aftercare done
not_allowed: Marketing email to the 15 not subscribed or no email; any message to the Temu buyer except order service (marketplace customer)
compatibility_notes: See compatibility list in 01-customers-recovery.md section 8 (9 subscribed customers bought a bed/base without a mattress; 8 bought a base without a headboard)
label: VERIFIED

name: Returning buyers (2+ paid orders)
definition: Same Shopify customer record with 2 paid orders: C002 (#1002 + #1005 – both draft orders 16 days apart) and C026 (#1027 + #1033 – 20 days apart); 2 of 38 paid orders (5.3%) are repeat orders
eligible_actions: Thank-you / service; ask (by the owner) whether a third room needs a bed – only after aftercare; no discount
compatibility_notes: C002 bought Double 4ft6 + Single 3ft frames without mattresses (mattress in each size would fit). C026 bought Super King + King gas-lift bases each with a mattress (headboard in 6ft and 5ft would be the only add-on – fixing compatibility UNKNOWN)
label: VERIFIED

name: Fulfilled orders (NOT the same as delivered)
definition: Paid orders marked FULFILLED in Shopify. Fulfilled is set before / without delivery (Stage 1/3/4: #1010 #1014 were 'fulfilled' with failed payment). Delivered date confirmed for 1 order only (#1038 delivered 17 Nov – owner via HQ inbox)
eligible_actions: Only after the owner confirms delivery: aftercare link + review request (C16). Do not use fulfilled date as delivered date
label: VERIFIED (fulfilled) / UNKNOWN (delivered)

name: Open enquiries (pre-purchase)
definition: HQ inbox items not yet an order: bespoke end-lift ottoman + firm mattress (price owed); made-to-measure bed (no reply yet); 2 swatch requests (swatches sent); Plymouth delivery chat (will order after move-in date); base-height question (answered 19 Nov)
eligible_actions: Reply to the question asked (service reply – no consent needed); one follow-up on the same enquiry; enquiry templates (Stage 3)
not_allowed: Adding to marketing lists; promotional follow-ups
compatibility_notes: Swatch requesters: check later orders before any follow-up (one swatch requester already ordered #1043)
label: VERIFIED (HQ) / UNKNOWN (consent – not matched to Shopify on purpose)

name: Aftercare window
definition: Paid orders placed 20 Oct–19 Nov (delivery / assembly / first weeks). Open issues: #1043 assembly promised but not paid (owner decision); #1040 delivery slot to send; #1038 delivered 17 Nov
eligible_actions: Service messages only: delivery booking; assembly instructions; aftercare page; one review request once delivered
not_allowed: Any marketing until delivery confirmed and no open issue
compatibility_notes: Aftercare messages are transactional and separate from marketing consent
label: VERIFIED

name: Abandoned-checkout visitors (real; not purchased)
definition: Of 21 abandoned checkouts (8 Sep–19 Nov): 12 bot/test; 1 no contact; 5 checkouts from 4 people who bought (#1016 #1022 #1034 #1035); 3 real with no order
eligible_actions: Subscribed one (12 Nov; Small Double gas-lift base): Shopify automation if Active. The 2 not subscribed: no marketing email; owner may answer if they contact us
not_allowed: Manual marketing email or WhatsApp to non-subscribed checkouts (PECR); any contact without first re-checking for a later order
compatibility_notes: 12 Nov: Small Double 4ft gas-lift base – a 4ft mattress would be the compatible add-on; 19 Nov: Grand Extra-Tall Double 4ft6; 19 Sep: Side-lift base Double 4ft6 (2 months old)
label: VERIFIED

name: Trade enquiries (inbound positive)
definition: Ivywell Interiors (Bristol interior designer) asked about COM (customer's own material); waiting for sizes / numbers; 0 trade orders
eligible_actions: Quote when sizes arrive (owner gives trade terms); no terms the owner has not given
not_allowed: Bulk cold email to sole traders/partnerships (PECR); fire-safety or hotel-supplier claims
compatibility_notes: COM metres per size needed from owner
label: VERIFIED

name: Unqualified / do not market
definition: 7 bot/test records (protonmail 'mailNNNNNNN' fictional names x6; throwaway plus-address x1 with 6 checkouts); 5 accounts created 14–15 Sep now UNSUBSCRIBED with no order (suspected spam sign-ups); 1 no-contact checkout record; 1 duplicate record of a buyer (#1035); 5 buyers whose only order was refunded (#1001 #1006) or cancelled (#1010 #1014 #1020) – review individually; 1 Temu marketplace buyer counted in A
eligible_actions: None (refunded / cancelled: service only; #1020 cancelled but shows PAID with £0 refunded – Stage 1 Q13 refund check still open)
label: VERIFIED (records) / ESTIMATE (spam sign-ups)

name: Accounts with no order (real sign-ups)
definition: Shop login / account / newsletter records with no order and no bot pattern (excludes F and H)
eligible_actions: Subscribed: newsletter-type content only when a newsletter exists (none planned in Stage 7)
not_allowed: Treating as customers (no soft opt-in: never bought)
label: VERIFIED
